intent: Left-clicking the ⏻ or 🎮 i3blocks block opens the daily-limits popup; before this, every click was a silent no-op.
changes: Root cause: the i3blocks process PATH has no ~/.local/bin, where daily-limits' install.sh puts the binary, so `command -v daily-limits` failed and the click was dropped
Both blocks call DAILY_LIMITS_BIN (default $HOME/.local/bin/daily-limits) by path, detached with setsid -f
A missing launcher raises a critical notify-send instead of doing nothing
Regression tests: click with PATH=/usr/bin:/bin runs `--gui`; missing launcher notifies

verification.command: env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin BLOCK_BUTTON=1 DAILY_LIMITS_BIN=<stub> bash i3blocks/{gaming_budget,shutdown_countdown}.sh (i3blocks' real PATH from /proc/<pid>/environ)
verification.evidence: stub log: 'clicked --gui' twice; block output unchanged (🎮 2h35 left · 2h25/5h00 ..., ⏻ 22:00 ... →max 23:00)
All gaming_budget checks passed. / All shutdown hint tests passed. / All i3blocks efficiency regression tests passed.

risks: If daily-limits is installed elsewhere, DAILY_LIMITS_BIN must be set in the i3blocks environment
rollback: git revert this commit; clicks go back to doing nothing under i3blocks' PATH
